site_sample_riverside.assessorName: T. Jackson, Sale Fish Marketing and Consulting

FR1.notes: Operators share two HMI logins per shift; engineering accounts are individual. Domain accounts for EWS only.

FR2.notes: USB ports disabled on HMIs, but the two engineering laptops are unrestricted.

FR3.notes: No logic-change detection. Firmware is downloaded from vendor portals without signature checks.

FR4.notes: No cloud services in use (FR4 Q3 marked N/A). Historian shares process data with corporate by file transfer.

FR5.notes: Flat control network: Lines 1–3, SIS engineering and historian share one VLAN. Firewall to corporate is 'any-any' for 10.20.0.0/16.

FR6.notes: No OT network monitoring. IR plan exists (corporate IT plan) and was used in the September tabletop.

FR7.notes: PLC backups taken ad hoc by the controls engineer; last full restore test unknown.

site_sample_bayport.assessorName: T. Jackson, Sale Fish Marketing and Consulting

AC.notes: Remote vendor access through CyberArk with approval workflow; RBAC on the terminal SCADA.

IA.notes: MFA on all remote access since 2025. Device certificates not used (Modbus/TCP only).

SC.notes: Industrial DMZ in place; conduit rules reviewed annually. No SIS at this site (SC Q3 marked N/A).

AU.notes: Passive monitoring sensor at the DMZ boundary only; alerts go to the corporate SOC with generic rules.

IR.notes: Reporting obligations are handled by Legal after the fact, not built into the playbook.

CM.notes: Asset inventory last reconciled 2024. No patch test environment.

site_sample_lakecharles.assessorName: T. Jackson, Sale Fish Marketing and Consulting

SEG.notes: Segmentation architecture documented in the TSA-approved CIP; one undocumented cellular modem found on the metering skid.

ACC.notes: MFA enforced on VPN and PAM. Session recording on, but recordings aren't reviewed.

PATCH.notes: Risk-based patching documented; compensating controls not recorded for the 14 deferred items.

IRPT.notes: CIRP still references the 24-hour window; needs updating for SD Pipeline-2021-01G (72 hours).

TPA.notes: Architectural design review overdue (last performed 2024). Assessment findings tracked in a spreadsheet with no owners.
